title: Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?
abstract: arXiv:2611.32131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have shown strong capabilities on complex tasks, yet how to control their reasoning effort remains a significant challenge for practical deployment. This paper provides a systematic investigation of reasoning-effort training, contrasting reinforcement learning (RL) with on-policy distillation (OPD). We find that compressing reasoning and separating effort tiers are governed by different signals. Length-penalized RL reliably compresses a single policy, reducing thinking on AIME25 by 70\% without accuracy loss, but collapses the tiers when they are trained jointly. Multi-teacher OPD separates them: across 33 benchmarks, low and medium use 58\% and 43\% fewer thinking tokens than high, while high improves on the reference policy by 3.1 points. We trace this difference to the training signal. A sequence-level reward cannot tell tier-specific behavior from shared behavior, whereas OPD supplies a tier-specific target at e

translated_title: 重新思考大语言模型的推理努力训练：策略内蒸馏还是强化学习？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在复杂任务上已展现出强大的能力，然而如何控制其推理努力仍是实际部署中的一项重大挑战。本文对推理努力训练进行了系统性研究，对比了强化学习（RL）与策略内蒸馏（OPD）。我们发现，压缩推理与分离努力层级受不同信号的支配。带长度惩罚的强化学习能够可靠地压缩单一策略，在AIME25上减少70%的思考量且不损失准确率，但当多个层级联合训练时会导致层级崩溃。多教师策略内蒸馏则能实现层级分离：在33个基准测试中，低层级和中层级分别比高层级少使用58%和43%的思考token，而高层级相比参考策略提升了3.1分。我们将这一差异归因于训练信号：序列级别的奖励无法区分层级特异性行为与共享行为，而策略内蒸馏则能在每个……
tldr: 带长度惩罚的强化学习虽能压缩单一策略的推理长度，却无法联合训练多个推理努力层级；而多教师策略内蒸馏凭借层级特定的训练目标，能够同时实现推理压缩与层级分离。
en_tdlr: Length-penalized RL reliably compresses reasoning for a single policy but collapses when effort tiers are trained jointly, while multi-teacher on-policy distillation achieves both compression and tier separation by supplying tier-specific training targets.
